args.cover_letter:
For Machine Learning: in the contract Q&A assistant for a mid-size law firm project I built a retrieval-augmented assistant with clause-level chunking, hybrid search on pgvector and citations back to the source page. For Python: in the payment fraud detection with graph neural networks project I modelled accounts, devices and cards as a graph in Neo4j and trained a GraphSAGE classifier.

I have not used TensorFlow in client work, so I would start with a short spike and confirm the approach with you before building on it.

Since you need speed and a clear plan for the deadline, my plan is a short discovery call, a first working milestone you can test, then documentation and a handover call.

If this sounds right, I can send a one-page plan for the first milestone today.
answers: My contract Q&A assistant for a mid-size law firm project: Cut clause review time by 41% across 9 associates; answers cite the exact page. The case study and code are in my marketplace portfolio and I can walk you through them on a call.
I would rather discuss this on a short call.
